name: Toonami Aftermath
description: Watch the Toonami Aftermath live channels (East, West, Movies, Radio, Snickelodeon, MTV97). Each channel shows up as its own creator with a live stream and a now-playing title.
author: Community

settings.name: Stream base URL
settings.description: Where the channel playlists live: <base>/<channel>/playlist.m3u8. Change this only if the site moves its streams.

settings.name: Schedule API base URL
settings.description: Used only to show the current show/episode in the title.

settings.name: Show now-playing titles
settings.description: Fetch the schedule so the title shows the current show. If off, titles are just the channel name.

settings.name: West schedule shift (hours)
settings.description: Added to schedule times reported for the West/PST channels. Leave at 0 unless the now-playing title looks hours off.
